_about: Executor's second reading, 2026-11-19, of the eleven-question rerun. Read in full: every answer the blind readers did not mark right (3), every answer they marked outside_wrong (6), the three X41 answers, and the other X12 and X31 answers, plus a random 12 of the rest (seed 20261119). 30 of 54 in all. No verdict differs from the blind readers'. says_unchecked is a hand count among the 30 read.
